## Static Analysis Config (Current `pyproject.toml`)

```toml
[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py310"
line-length = 120
exclude = [".git", "__pycache__", "*.egg-info", "logs"]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "W", "UP", "B", "C4", "SIM"]
ignore = ["E501", "E402"]  # E402 stays until sys.path hacks removed (Cleanup C2)

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.10"
ignore_missing_imports = true
follow_imports = "silent"
warn_unused_ignores = true
no_strict_optional = true
exclude = ["logs/", "scripts/legacy/"]
# strict = false globally; per-module overrides added as packages finish (Cleanup C3)
```

## CI Workflow (Planned — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`)

```yaml
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: [checkout, setup-uv, uv sync --all-extras, ruff check, mypy .]

  unit-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: [checkout, setup-uv, uv sync --group core --group eval, pytest -q ...]

  windows-tests:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, windows, arm64]
    if: false  # flip when runner exists
    steps: [checkout, setup-uv, uv sync --group core --group windows --group native-win32 --group eval, playwright install, pytest -q automation/tests/]

  dgx-integration:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, dgx]
    if: false  # flip when runner exists
    steps: [checkout, setup-uv, uv sync --group core --group dgx --group galaxy --group eval, pytest -q tests/e2e_golden_path_dgx.py tests/e2e_galaxy_constellation.py]
```
